warm-referral.subject: one intro
warm-referral.body:

Who do you know running a food brand, restaurant or bottled product whose photography doesn't match how good the actual product is?

multi-location.subject: your {{locations}} locations
multi-location.body:
{{name}} -

{{observation}}

With {{locations}} locations that compounds: each one ends up looking like a different business, and the one people judge you on is whichever they happen to find first.

I'm a chef who shoots commercially. The way I'd handle it is to build the look once - lighting, color, how the spaces and the food are framed - and then shoot each location to it, so the second and third cost less than the first.

If it's useful I'll put a one-page plan together for one location, free, and you can judge it from that. Want it?

Larry
Apex Content Studio
rules: Under 140 words
Only for rows with a recorded location count of 2+
No price
One question only
The plan is for ONE location - never open at the full group
